claims.text: P13: an account imported into the case after sign-off is no longer among the recorded inputs. verify recomputes only the accounts the pack recorded (inputs.statements), through the new accounts= parameter of overrides.case_figures. So the new account neither pairs with the signed one nor shows up as 'not recorded'. Before the fix this test failed with 22 mismatches, the first being 'account main: figure M2 value' 1050.95 vs 550.35.

R44: recorded and recomputed values are compared as JSON values (_same), so a boolean is never equal to a number. M7 and M13 set to true/false, and a monthly cell value set to a boolean, are reported as mismatches. A part_month given as 0/1 is refused.

R44: malformed record shapes now raise VerifyRefused (exit 2) instead of a traceback or wrong override slicing. Cases covered: accounts None; non-object monthly cells; inputs.statements or inputs.override_log that are not objects; an override_log position that is negative, a boolean, None or missing; own_account_pairing_days given as a string, a boolean or a negative number; money_in.total or cash_within_trading that is not a figure with a text id; duplicate metric ids, months, accounts or bucket ids; a run record whose statement sha256 is missing or empty. Total money in (M17) and M18 are compared in their own places, so moving M17 into the buckets is a mismatch.
The P13 and P3 invariants in test_verify.py still pass, including the 12 generated two-account packs.
Lint and compile are clean, and the full suite passes.
claims.proof_cmd: ruff check src tests evals && python -m compileall -q src && echo COMPILED && python -m pytest -q -x 2>&1 | tail -3

dispositions.finding: major P13 src/cma/verify.py:265 — _verify_pack recomputes over every account currently in the case log instead of inputs['statements']; an account imported after sign-off pairs with the signed one and fails verification.
dispositions.evidence: Reproduced by test_p13_an_account_imported_after_sign_off_is_not_among_the_recorded_inputs, which failed on the old code with 22 mismatches. Fix: overrides.case_figures takes accounts=, and _verify_pack passes inputs['statements']. The test now passes with no mismatches and 28 figures checked.

dispositions.finding: major R44 src/cma/verify.py:118 — _compare/_compare_months use plain != so True==1.0, False==0.0, 0==False hide tampered figures, cells and part_month.
dispositions.evidence: Comparisons now go through _same, which compares JSON values and treats a boolean as equal only to a boolean. part_month must be a boolean, or the record is refused. Test: test_a_boolean_in_place_of_a_number_is_a_mismatch_and_a_flag_given_as_a_number_is_refused.

dispositions.finding: major R44 src/cma/verify.py:318 — _check_shape misses malformed shapes: accounts None; non-dict monthly cells; non-dict inputs.statements/override_log; non-int pairing days; bool/negative/None position; malformed money_in.total/cash_within_trading.
dispositions.evidence: _check_shape now covers each of these. It requires accounts to be a list. _months checks part_month, start, end and each cell's type. _figure checks money_in.total and cash_within_trading. _check_inputs requires statements to be an object of text hashes, position to be a whole number of records (not a boolean), and own_account_pairing_days to be a whole number. _verify_pack passes those values straight through, never None. Tests: the parametrised test_a_malformed_run_record_is_refused_never_raised and test_a_malformed_pack_record_is_refused_never_raised_or_misread, which cover every repro the finding gives.

dispositions.finding: minor R44 src/cma/verify.py:200 — _verify_run skips the statement hash check when statement.sha256 is null, empty or absent.
dispositions.evidence: A run record (v0 or v1) with no text sha256 is now refused. Both releases' evidence records write one. Tested by the _no_sha and empty-sha cases of test_a_malformed_run_record_is_refused_never_raised.

dispositions.finding: minor R44 src/cma/verify.py:108 — duplicate metric/bucket/month/account entries, or M17 moved from money_in.total into buckets, verify with zero mismatches.
dispositions.evidence: _list_of_objects now refuses a key given more than once, which covers metrics, months, accounts and buckets (the duplicate cases in the malformed-record tests). _compare_money_in compares total and cash_within_trading each in its own place, so moving M17 into the buckets gives 'account main: bucket total' (test_a_bucket_moved_out_of_its_place_is_a_mismatch).

notes: verify is stricter now: a malformed record is refused (exit 2) rather than reported as a mismatch (exit 1). In particular, a part_month given as 0/1 is refused, not reported as a mismatch. I did not re-run the evals or the dual_run tier on their own; both are inside the full pytest run only where they are pytest tests. The committed example and the generated two-account packs still verify with no mismatch.
